Package org.ujorm.orm.core

Class EntityManager<D,V>

java.lang.Object
org.ujorm.orm.core.EntityManager<D,V>
Type Parameters:
D - Domain class
V - Primary key class
public final class EntityManager<D,V> extends Object
The Entity Manager for the JDBC API. Each method may throw an unchecked SQLException.

It is highly recommended to call the crud(Connection) method as part of the class initialization to pre-build the internal table model safely.

    • map

    • map

      public D map(@NotNull @NotNull ResultSet rs, @Nullable @Nullable CharSequence... columnLabels)
      Maps a single ResultSet row to the Domain object.

      Usage: Best suited for isolated, single-row mappings where you only need to process a specific, individual record without iterating through a large dataset.

      Relationship: This is a convenience wrapper that internally creates a mapping function (similar to calling mapper(CharSequence...)) and applies it immediately. Because it resolves the mapping function and column metadata on every single call, it is less efficient for processing large result sets in a loop compared to reusing the function provided directly by mapper(CharSequence...).

      Parameters:
      rs - The ResultSet positioned at the current row.
      columnLabels - Optional custom column labels to map.
      Returns:
      A newly instantiated Domain object mapped from the ResultSet.

    • mapper

      @NotNull public @NotNull AbstractSqlQuery.SqlFunction<ResultSet,D> mapper(@Nullable @Nullable CharSequence... columnLabels)
      Returns a stateful mapper (mapping function) for efficient processing of multiple rows.

      Usage: Highly recommended for stream processing (e.g., .streamMap(entityManager.mapper())) or manual while(rs.next()) loops. By instantiating the mapper exactly once outside the loop, column metadata is resolved upfront. This makes it significantly more efficient for bulk operations.

      Relationship: Acts as the core mapping mechanism. While map(ResultSet, CharSequence...) creates and consumes this function on the fly for a single use, this method exposes the reusable function for high-performance, repeated iteration.

      Parameters:
      columnLabels - Optional custom column labels to map.
      Returns:
      A reusable mapping function.
